correctness.rationale: The exact identity Wdot=-(1-S) Lambda is checked symbolically from the printed system at the critical equality; positive compact forward invariance plus LaSalle gives infected-state extinction and logistic comparison gives S->1. The irreducible Metzler Jacobian has a simple zero Perron mode and stable complement, with relative change of W tending to 0. Stable convolution shows Z/W->v/D and u/W->K/D. Thus (1/W)dot->mu*K/D^2 and all four limits follow by Cesàro. Numerical tests of 6 trajectories are supplementary only. Edge beta1=0 and all seed configurations allowed by assumptions are included.

value.rationale: At a biologically motivated coexistence/extinction threshold, qualitative clearance alone hides slow infection and fomite persistence. The four explicit universal coefficients separate environmental decay time omega and host recovery r, provide physically interpretable transient duration factors, and include purely indirect transmission. This is motivated exact asymptotic information, not an arbitrary evaluated parameter instance.
